name: phase_01_api_credentials
lock_risk: New Identity tables and grants do not scan or rewrite existing product rows; apply under the bounded migration lock timeout.
representative_data: Exercise empty/current/previous lanes plus real PostgreSQL create, redacted replay, rotation overlap, explicit revocation, expiry, environment/audience/scope rejection, Audit outage, and concurrent authorization tests.
query_plan_review: Credential lifecycle queries use exact tenant and key predicates, the tenant-created list index, and row locks; authentication uses the credential primary key before bounded metadata updates.
space_risk: Only bounded credential metadata, SHA-256 verifier/network digests, lifecycle links, and idempotency facts are stored. Plaintext secrets and raw network addresses are prohibited.
forward_fix: Disable credential creation and rotation, preserve revocation and Audit truth, and add an ordered migration for any verifier, constraint, grant, or lifecycle correction.
rollback: Before release, remove only with all S08 state uncommitted. After release, never recover plaintext, resurrect revoked keys, or drop credential/Audit history; disable routes and forward-fix.
